hook.name: MeridianHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Meridian launchpad that manages single-sided concentrated liquidity positions for token launches. It collects custom fees on buys (via beforeSwapReturnsDelta) and sells (via afterSwapReturnsDelta), with a time-decaying anti-snipe fee at launch, and locks the liquidity position so only the hook itself can add or remove it.
